biggest_catch: It's a limited-time offer available only when you sign up online or via chat — not in retail stores — and the $300 virtual prepaid Mastercard can take up to 14 weeks after you submit the rebate. Miss the rebate submission window (within 30 days of activation at promotions.t-mobile.com) and you get nothing.

Rebate must be submitted (promotions.t-mobile.com, within 30 days of activation).
Allow up to 14 weeks from rebate submission for the virtual card.
The $300 is a virtual prepaid Mastercard, not cash.
